dedupe_keys.name: 避難場所一覧 海南市 evacuation shelters and public facilities

description: 避難場所一覧_海南市 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 海南市. 和歌山県海南市の災害時における避難所・避難場所等の一覧です。. Coverage: 海南市. The portal files it under the publisher 海南市. Its tags are 位置情報, 指定緊急避難場所, 指定避難所, 津波避難ビル, 海南市. It offers 8 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-01-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Data License 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
